sanskrit: tannaumi sāhasavaraṃ guruvaktragamyam ko'pyanuttaracidvyomasvabhāvo jayatādajaḥ pūjyapūjakapūjābhiḥ projjhitaṃ yannamāmi tat mahāvyomasamāviṣṭastisṭhāmyasminnirāvilaḥ saṃvidvikalpasaṃkalpaghaṭṭanaṃ naumyanuttaram kenāpi kriyate samyakparatattvopabṛṃhitā mahāsāhasavṛttyā svarūpalābhaḥ vakṣyamāṇakathitakrameṇā-dhigantavyaḥ satatamavasthitiḥ sthitetyarthaḥ ḥ prāptamahopadeśanāmāvirbhavatītyar-thaḥ yugmagrāsānniravakāśasaṃvinniṣṭhā nirupādhinīrūpaniḥsvarūpatādātmyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ siddhayoginīsaṃghaṭṭānmahāmelāpodayaḥ paramādvayasamāveśaḥ sarvatrāvasthita ityuktaṃ bhavati bhavatīti saṃbandhaḥ yathāmukhopadiṣṭanītyā svara eva prathate, - ityuktaṃ bhavati vigatabandhaṃ paraṃ brahma vibhātīti rahasyārthaḥ svaviśrāntyavasthitiḥ vasthitiḥ pañcamapadātiśāyinī niravakāśasaṃvinniṣṭhā sthitetyarthaḥ dvādaśavāhodayena mahāmarīcivikāsaḥ tayā sarvatra sarvataḥ sarvadaiva sthita iti mahāvākyārthaḥ caryāpañcakodaye nistaraṅgasamāveśaḥ caryāpañcakodayaḥ
bandhamokṣobhayottīrṇamahāmuktiḥ karatalāmalakavat sthitetyarthaḥ prāptyā khasvaratā svena rāti vyāpnoti svīkaroti ādatte, - iti khasvaraḥ
